e: Maboroshi no ichigo pantsu/Gokai soretomo kan chigai?
Yureru renai benkyôkai/Maboroshi no bishôjo futatabi!
Omoide no daini botan/Haru no arashi wa osananajimi
Haran no hai sukûru raifu/Sure chigau kokoro to omoi
Panikku in mai rûmu/Dotô no natsugasshuku
Sei ippai no purezento/Ikisaki husei no kimochi
Boppatsu! Nanboku sensô/Tatta hitori no kuisumasu
Yume no tsuzuki o mô ichido/Yuki no naka de dakishimete
Sure chigai no barentain/Amakute nigai chokorêto
Reberu appu no osatsu/Doki doki hatsu dêto
